facts.bull-throne: The king sits on a throne with bull's-head ornaments.
facts.grape-robe: He wears a black robe covered with a pattern of grape bunches and vines.
facts.scepter-pentacle: He holds a scepter with a round ball in his right hand, and rests a pentacle on his knee with his left.
facts.flower-crown: He wears a crown decorated with flowers and leaves.
facts.castle: At the back right, a castle and its walls can be seen.
facts.vines: Grapevines and flowers grow thick around him, and the sky is yellow.
facts.foot-carving: One armored foot rests on a carved animal head at his feet.

glosses.castle: The base and the territory built up.

reversedGloss.excess: Too tied to material things and results.
reversedGloss.waning: The base built up begins to shake, and the responsibility feels heavy.

misdescriptions.wrong: He sits on a pile of gold coins.
